svg.text: Common Divisors Tile the a×b Rectangle; gcd Is the Largest
Refinement type: Gcd(12, 8) = { g ∈ ℕ | Div(g) = Div(12) ∩ Div(8) } = { 4 }
1. Every candidate square side d ∈ {1 … 6} tested against the 12 × 8 rectangle:
d ∣ 12 ∧ d ∣ 8 ⇔ d×d squares tile 12×8 with zero overhang
2. Why the type { g ∈ ℕ | Div(g) = Div(12) ∩ Div(8) } has a single inhabitant g = 4:
Every valid d-tile grid nests inside the 4×4 master tile:
Base Type ℕ Refined by Predicate Div(g) = {1, 2, 4}
